options.text: Atoms of the same element with different numbers of neutrons
Atoms of the same element with different numbers of electrons
Atoms of different elements with the same mass number
Atoms of the same element with different numbers of protons

questions.explanation: Isotopes are atoms of the same element (same number of protons) but with different numbers of neutrons. This means they have the same atomic number but different mass numbers. They share the same chemical properties but may differ in stability.
